name: Image Crop Field
summary: React image upload and crop field built on shadcn/ui, wrapping react-easy-crop and react-image-crop.
description: Form field component for uploading and cropping images, with zoom from 0.5x to 5x, rotation from -45 to +45 degrees, locked aspect ratio or free crop, and output files at exact dimensions via canvas. Integrates with React Hook Form and Zod and targets Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS 4; a playground route demos the options.
contains: upload and crop field with preview, zoom 0.5x-5x and rotation -45 to 45 degrees
hybrid engine: react-easy-crop for fixed aspect, react-image-crop for free crop
outputs images at exact dimensions (e.g. 1200x630) via canvas
React Hook Form + Zod integration with max file size limit
Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS 4
playground route to test crop shape, ratio and free crop
